known.title: Restore keyboard focus when the invite dialog closes

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - an admin opens Invite person with the keyboard and closes it with Esc or Cancel. The opener in members-page.tsx:57 sits outside this Dialog, with no DialogTrigger registered and no onCloseAutoFocus fallback. The shared dialog.tsx:61 forwards directly to Radix, whose modal close handler prevents default focus restoration and focuses its trigger ([Radix implementation](https://github.com/radix-ui/primitives/blob/main/packages/react/dialog/src/dialog.tsx)). Consequently, closing this dialog loses keyboard focus instead of returning it to Invite person. Put the opener under the same Dialog with DialogTrigger, or explicitly restore focus on close.
